## Problem 1

### a.

```{r}
library(foreign)

# read the data
aux <- read.xport("AUX_I.xpt")
dem <- read.xport("DEMO_I.xpt")

# merge the data
merged <- merge(aux, dem, by = "SEQN", all = FALSE)

names(merged) <- tolower(names(merged))
dim(merged)
```

### b.

1. gender
```{r}
table(merged$riagendr, useNA = 'ifany')

# rename
names(merged)[names(merged) == "riagendr"] <- "female"

# convert to 0 = male and 1 = female
merged$female <- merged$female - 1

# create a table
table(merged$female, useNA = 'ifany')
```
gender : no missing value, rename, no need to make binary variables factors.

2. citizenship status
```{r}
table(merged$dmdcitzn, useNA = 'ifany')

# convert invalid or missing to NA
merged$dmdcitzn[merged$dmdcitzn > 3] <- NA

# convert to a factor
merged$dmdcitzn <- as.factor(merged$dmdcitzn)
levels(merged$dmdcitzn) <- c(
  "Citizen",
  "Not a citizen"
)

# rename
names(merged)[names(merged) == "dmdcitzn"] <- "citizenship"

table(merged$citizenship, useNA = "ifany")
```
3. # of children
```{r}
# rename
names(merged)[names(merged) == "dmdhhsza"] <- "numchild"

table(merged$numchild, useNA = "ifany")
```

4. annual household income
```{r}
table(merged$indhhin2, useNA = 'ifany')

# convert refused, dk, and overlapping income categories to NA
merged$indhhin2[
  merged$indhhin2 > 15 |
  merged$indhhin2 %in% c(12, 13)
] <- NA

# rename
names(merged)[names(merged) == "indhhin2"] <- "hhinc"

merged$hhinc[merged$hhinc == 14] <- 11
merged$hhinc[merged$hhinc == 15] <- 12
table(merged$hhinc, useNA = 'ifany')

# check the cleaned variable
table(merged$hhinc, useNA = "ifany")
```

### c.

```{r}
# 1R - Right ear: gender
mod1r <- glm(
  auxtwidr ~ female,
  data = merged,
  family = poisson
)

# 2R - Right ear: gender, citizenship status, number of children, annual household income
mod2r <- glm(
  auxtwidr ~ female + citizenship + numchild + hhinc,
  data = merged,
  family = poisson
)

# 1L - Left ear: gender
mod1l <- glm(
  auxtwidl ~ female,
  data = merged,
  family = poisson
)

# 2L - Left ear: gender, citizenship status, number of children, annual household income
mod2l <- glm(
  auxtwidl ~ female + citizenship + numchild + hhinc,
  data = merged,
  family = poisson
)

# combine coefficients
coef_table <- cbind(
  c(coef(mod1r), rep(NA, length(coef(mod2r)) - length(coef(mod1r)))),
  coef(mod2r),
  c(coef(mod1l), rep(NA, length(coef(mod2l)) - length(coef(mod1l)))),
  coef(mod2l)
)

# convert to IRR
coef_table <- exp(coef_table)

rownames(coef_table) <- names(coef(mod2l))
colnames(coef_table) <- c(
  "Model 1R",
  "Model 2R",
  "Model 1L",
  "Model 2L"
)

coef_table <- round(coef_table, 3)
mode(coef_table) <- "character"
coef_table[is.na(coef_table)] <- ""

# display a formatted table
knitr::kable(
  coef_table,
  align = "cccc",
  caption = "Incidence Risk Ratios for Poisson Regression Models"
)
```
```{r}
library(pscl)

# calculate model summary stat
calc_stat <- function(model) {
  c(
    "Sample size" = length(model$fitted.values),
    "Pseudo R^2" = unname(pR2(model)["McFadden"]),
    "AIC" = AIC(model)
  )
}

# combine
fit_table <- cbind(
  calc_stat(mod1r),
  calc_stat(mod2r),
  calc_stat(mod1l),
  calc_stat(mod2l)
)

# add col name
colnames(fit_table) <- c(
  "Model 1R",
  "Model 2R",
  "Model 1L",
  "Model 2L"
)

fit_table <- round(fit_table, 3)

knitr::kable(
  fit_table,
  align = "cccc",
  caption = "Model Fit Statistics"
)
```
